Name: Electronic Arts Inc
Description: Electronic Arts Inc. (EA) is a leading American video game company headquartered in Redwood City, California, renowned for its development and publishing of interactive entertainment software. As the second-largest gaming company by revenue and market capitalization in the Americas and Europe, EA boasts a diverse portfolio of iconic franchises, including FIFA, Madden NFL, and The Sims. With a strong emphasis on innovation and player engagement, EA has successfully expanded its digital footprint through live services and subscription models, positioning itself for sustained growth in the dynamic gaming industry.
